admin.description: Full rights including Sync Console, Settings, Delete Work Order, Review/Approve.

supervisor.description: Can start/end work orders and jobs, pick resources and assets, no create rights on web.

responsible.description: Assigned as responsible on at least two work orders.

operator.description: Mapped to a machine resource with implements.

farmhand.description: Minimum permissions - used for negative permission checks.

multiGrower.description: Mapped to two growers with different location sets, for hierarchy checks.

restrictedLocation.description: Rights to one location only, for isolation checks.

bypassAttendance.description: Member of a user group with Bypass Attendance enabled.

inactive.description: A user deactivated in Settings, for login-refusal checks.
